N14#1.zh: 哼...原来早就已经有准备了...
N14#1.t: Hmph... so you were ready all along...

N14#2.zh: 混江湖的人小心一点总是比较好...%N，你也是个明智的人；早点投降的话，只要留下你们全身家当，我还可以留你们一条狗命...
N14#2.t: In the rivers and lakes it pays to be careful... %N, you're a sensible man. Surrender now and leave everything you own, and I may still spare your dogs' lives...

N14#3.zh: 笑话！今天不是你死就是我亡！
N14#3.t: Nonsense! Today it's you or me!

N14#4.zh: 哼...搞不清状况的家伙。在人数差这么多的情况下，你们根本没有机会！喽罗们，谁能拿下他们其中任何人的首级，我保证升他当个头领！
N14#4.t: Hmph... you don't understand your position. Outnumbered like this, you haven't a chance! Men, whoever brings me the head of any one of them, I promise to make a chief!

N14#6.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打败所有敌人（包括增援；王伦一死，增援立刻赶到）
N14#6.t: Victory --- Defeat all enemies (including reinforcements; the moment Wang Lun dies, reinforcements arrive)

N14#9.zh: 吾乃『摸著天』杜迁！什么人敢上梁山撒野！
N14#9.t: I am 'Sky Toucher' Du Qian! Who dares run wild on Liangshan!

N14#10.zh: 『云里金刚』宋万在此！谁敢动我大哥！
N14#10.t: 'Cloud Guardian' Song Wan is here! Who dares touch my brother!

N14#11.t: The second and third chiefs are here!

N14#12.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！

N14#13.zh: %N死亡，众人一哄而散，逃至山下，遭遇官兵埋伏，在王伦与官兵联手围剿下，无一幸免........
N14#13.t: %N died. The others scattered and fled down the mountain, straight into an army ambush. Caught between Wang Lun and the soldiers, not one survived........

N14#14.zh: 王伦不义！此人心胸狭隘，嫉贤妒能；我林冲今日替天行道，杀了这个无义之人！
N14#14.t: Wang Lun is without honour! A narrow-minded man, jealous of the worthy and able. Today I, Lin Chong, act on Heaven's behalf and kill this faithless man!

N14#15.t: We'll follow you, brother, holding your whip and stirrup!

N14#16.t: ...With our big brother dead, I, Du Qian, surrender.

N14#17.zh: 唉！打不过你们，我宋万也投降！
N14#17.t: Sigh! I can't beat you, so I, Song Wan, surrender too!

N14#18.zh: 如果有不服者，就以王伦为例！今日就扶林教头为山寨之主！
N14#18.t: Anyone who won't submit, look at Wang Lun! Today we raise Instructor Lin as master of the stronghold!

N14#19.zh: 先生所言差矣。我今日只为了众豪杰义气，火拼了这个不仁之贼，其实并无心要谋此位。今日先生却要林冲坐上这个第一位，岂不让天下英雄耻笑？倘若先生相逼，林冲唯有一死以明志！林冲有一言，不知各位肯不肯听从？
N14#19.t: You're wrong, sir. Today I only fought out of loyalty to the heroes and killed this heartless thief; I have no wish to take his seat. If you make me, Lin Chong, sit in first place, wouldn't the heroes of the land laugh at me? If you press me, I'll die to prove my intent! I have one word to say; will you all hear it?

N14#20.zh: 林教头所言，谁敢不依？愿闻其言。
N14#20.t: Who would dare not follow Instructor Lin? Let us hear it.

N14#21.zh: 唯有有德者才能坐上这梁山第一位！
N14#21.t: Only a man of virtue may sit in first place on Liangshan!

N14#22.zh: %N少年英雄，仗义执言、济弱扶倾不在人后；将来前途不可限量！我建议由%N坐上这第一把交椅。
N14#22.t: %N is a young hero who speaks out for justice and helps the weak second to none; his future is boundless! I propose %N take the first seat.

N14#23.zh: %N只是个后生小辈，岂有资格统领众多梁山好汉？今有晁兄仗义疏财，智勇兼备；方今天下人，闻其名没有不服者。我等今日以义气为重，立他为山寨之主，如何？
N14#23.t: %N is just a youngster. How could he lead so many Liangshan heroes? Brother Chao is generous and righteous, both wise and brave; there's no one in the land who hears his name and doesn't respect him. Let us put loyalty first today and make him master of the stronghold. What do you say?

N14#25.zh: 不可。自古『强宾不压主。』晁盖只是个远来新到的人，安敢占上？
N14#25.t: I can't. Since ancient times, 'a strong guest doesn't overrule the host.' I, Chao Gai, am a newcomer from afar. How could I take the top seat?

N14#26.zh: 今日事情已经到这个地步，你就不要再推托了。
N14#26.t: Things have come this far today. Don't refuse any more.

N14#27.zh: 众人在聚义厅上依照个人年龄威望，排定座位；%N坐了第二位，吴用坐了第三位，公孙胜坐了第四位...包括梁山旧头领杜迁、宋万，众人皆坐了一把交椅。山前山后七八百人都来参拜，梁山泊新添了这么多英雄豪杰，更是气象一新。
N14#27.t: In the Hall of Loyalty they took their seats by age and standing: %N second, Wu Yong third, Gongsun Sheng fourth... and the old Liangshan chiefs Du Qian and Song Wan each had a chair too. Seven or eight hundred men from the front and back of the mountain came to pay their respects. With so many new heroes, Liangshan Marsh took on a whole new air.
